node.title: L1 background-surplus Plotkin payment
node.statement: Stratify one exact support/defect cell by exact background agreement count u+z. Using every background agreement, the combined core/background sets have distance at least 2(ell+z). Thus the cell has at most 2^(E_z+1)n members for E_z=N+b-4(ell+z)>=0, and every fixed logarithmic effective-excess window E_z<=C log_2 n is polynomial per chart at fixed petal polarity. A counterfamily must have (E_P-4z)/log_2 n unbounded. Officially, (r-1)E_z=(M-3(r-1)+1)ell-r(g+1)-4(r-1)z. No background-subset factor is introduced because the exact set is determined by the numerator.
